problem:
Which of the following equalities are true given that
$D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le \sqrt{2},\,-\sqrt{3}\le y\le 2}.$

- ${∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A={\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}{\int }_{-\sqrt{3}}^{2}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x$
- ${∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A={\int }_{-\sqrt{3}}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y$
- ${∬}_{D}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}A={\int }_{-\sqrt{3}}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2}}\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x$

feedback.worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $y$, treating $x$ as a constant:    

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{5}[{\int }_{0}^{1}\frac{{5}^{y}}{x}\,\text{d}y]\text{d}x & ={\int }_{1}^{5}\frac{1}{x}[{\int }_{0}^{1}{5}^{y}\,\text{d}y]\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{5}\frac{1}{x}{[\frac{{5}^{y}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}]}_{0}^{1}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{5}\frac{1}{x}(\frac{{5}^{1}-{5}^{0}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5})\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{5}\frac{1}{x}(\frac{4}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5})\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{5}\frac{4}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}\cdot \frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{5}\frac{4}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}\cdot \frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{4}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}[\operatorname{ln}⁡x]_{1}^{5} \\  & =\frac{4}{\operatorname{ln}⁡5}(\operatorname{ln}⁡5-\operatorname{ln}⁡1) \\  & =4\end{aligned}
$$
